{{Quote|You weren't supposed to survive your match with the wampa.|[[Sadiki Blirr]], to Darth Maul|<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" />}}
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] fought a '''wampa''' in forced [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat while in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Prison/Legends|penitentiary]] [[Cog Hive Seven]].<ref name="Maul: Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref> The [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] was infected with a [[Disease/Legends|disease]]<ref name="Schreiber Facebook">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=starwarsbooks/posts/10152224073028713|name=[[Joe Schreiber]]|date=2014-02-12|quote=the idea with the wampa is (or was, in some version of the story) that it is, in fact, infected with something. I'm going to keep it vague in the interest of spoilers, but yeah&hellip;definitely not your average garden variety wampa.|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: Could you explain exactly what your intentions were for the wampa?}}</ref> that infused it with greater durability and enabled it to continue fighting even after suffering blows that would have normally [[Death/Legends|killed]] it. Nevertheless, Maul eventually succeeded in [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|destroying]] the beast.<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" />
